findings.summary: Both driver tests inject a synthetic jitted mask program instead of driving the production mask path: the moment_finiteness kernel at nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py:1034 and the cell_moments closure at scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py:1242 are never exercised by any test, so a regression in the real moment-to-mask wiring leaves all five tests green.

The certificate driver checks the state before each step but never the state the final step returns, so a non-finite moment produced by the terminating step breaks the loop and flows unchecked into result terminal_state and terminal_panel instead of being refused.

The record names both host loops by function and enclosing loop but gives no line numbers, while the brief asked for each host loop to be named by function and line; the checks sit at nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py:1498 and scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py:172.
